items.title: Sozzi: Anthropic’s IPO Surges; Is AMD’s Pullback a Buy?
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the biggest stories to kick off the trading day, including the performance of Anthropic (ANT)’s IPO, whether AMD (AMD)’s pullback presents a buying opportunity, and Gap (GAP)’s fall earnings warning. Sozzi then sits down with former Bridgewater (BWB) Associates Chief Investment Strategist Rebecca Patterson and former BNY (BNY) Wealth Management CEO Catherine Keating to discuss their new book, Investment Wisdom, and how its lessons can help friends and loved ones navigate investing.
